essence: The goddess is a beneficent power who grants accomplishment and removes premature death for those in distress.
The goddess is both a granter of efficacious speech and a radiant figure adorned with rubies.
The goddess is identified through her essential connection to the māyā and vadhū seed syllables.
The goddess is envisioned as resplendent, clothed in colorful garments and richly ornamented.
The devotee petitions Kāmeśī to bestow a rare and difficult attainment.
